content: This medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the potential benefits to you outweigh the risks of side effects. However, it is important to note that this medication may increase your blood pressure. In rare cases, it can cause serious, potentially fatal lung or heart problems, such as pulmonary hypertension or heart valve issues. The risk of these complications increases with prolonged use of the medication or when it is taken in combination with other appetite-suppressant drugs or herbal products. Severe allergic reactions to this medication are rare, but they can occur. This document does not provide a complete list of possible side effects. If you are in the United States, contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. If you are in Canada, do the same. Precautions: Before taking phendimetrazine, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, to other sympathomimetic amines (such as decongestants like pseudoephedrine, stimulants like amphetamine, or appetite suppressants like phentermine), or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other problems. This medication may cause dizziness or blurred vision. In rare cases, it may also cause drowsiness. Alcohol or marijuana (cannabis) can exacerbate these effects, making you more dizzy or drowsy. Avoid driving, operating machinery, or performing tasks that require alertness or clear vision until you are sure you can do so safely. Refrain from consuming alcoholic beverages. If you have diabetes, monitor your blood sugar levels regularly as directed and share the results with your doctor. This medication should not be used during pregnancy, as weight loss offers no benefit to a pregnant woman and may harm an unborn baby. It is unknown whether this drug passes into breast milk, but similar drugs are known to do so. Breastfeeding is not recommended while using this medication. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions can alter how your medications work or increase your risk of serious side effects. This document does not list all possible drug interactions. Keep a list of all the products you use (including prescription and nonprescription drugs and herbal products) and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. This medication should not be used with certain other drugs due to the risk of very serious interactions. Taking MAO inhibitors (such as isocarboxazid, linezolid, methylene blue, moclobemide, phenelzine, procarbazine, rasagiline, safinamide, selegiline, or tranylcypromine) with this medication may cause a serious, potentially fatal interaction. Avoid taking MAO inhibitors during treatment with this medication. Most MAO inhibitors should also not be taken for two weeks before starting this medication. Check the labels on all your medications (such as allergy or cough-and-cold products) because they may contain ingredients that cause drowsiness. Some products may also contain ingredients that could raise your heart rate or blood pressure. Caffeine can increase the side effects of this medication. Overdose: If someone has overdosed and is experiencing serious symptoms such as passing out or trouble breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. Notes: Appetite suppressants should not be used as a substitute for a proper diet. Do not share this medication with others. Laboratory and/or medical tests (such as blood pressure, heart, or kidney function) may be performed while you are taking this medication. Keep all medical and lab appointments. Missed Dose: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of the next dose or late in the evening, skip the missed dose. Take your next dose at the regular time. Storage: Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Information: This document provides a summary and does not contain all possible information about this product. It does not guarantee that this product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for individual medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
